description: What demo.create builds with kind two-photon (Python's create_two_photon_demo, MATLAB's nansen.demo.createTwoPhoton): synthetic SciScan recordings of disk-shaped cells with calcium activity on a textured background, moving by whole pixels, with noise, and a project over them with the ophys variables set up. Every random number is a 32-bit hash of a seed and an index, so both languages write the same bytes.

project.name: TwoPhotonQuickstart
project.title: Two-photon quickstart
project.description: Synthetic two-photon recordings to try motion correction, ROI detection and signal extraction on.

presets.name: tutorial
presets.description: For the tutorial's cells, about 8 pixels across

seeds.note: Each subject's field of view (cells, background) is drawn from 100 x its number; each session's activity, motion and noise from that plus 10 x the session's number (numbers from 1). Added to them: 0 cell positions, 1 cell amplitudes, 2 coarse background, 3 fine background; 0 spikes, 1 motion, 2 noise.
